build_task_template: build a PHYRE task scene with ramps, teeter-totters, and a ball using build_task
create_cos_helper: create a helper function that computes cosine of an angle given in degrees
add_static_bar: create a static bar object in the PHYRE scene with specified angle, scale, and position
add_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object in the PHYRE scene at a given left and bottom position
update_task_relationships: update the PHYRE task to define touching relationships between the ball and target bodies
